review.abstract: The Jesuit-raised Sigismund proposes himself as the new tsar of Russia, followed by the forced conversion of the Muscovite people to Catholicism. The boyars refuse; war breaks out; Polish troops occupy Moscow. Also fighting as allies of the Poles are the Cossacks.
